canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Everett Financial, Inc. denied {value} of its 5,337 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Everett Financial, Inc. decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Everett Financial, Inc. will deny any specific future application with 10.2% probability
Everett Financial, Inc. is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Everett Financial, Inc. discriminates or violates law
10.2% applies to Everett Financial, Inc.'s non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
